description: Preview tracking an immutable Explore selection's searches, each under its Explore Topic, on the chosen platforms and cadence, without tracking anything. Returns the server plan, its planFingerprint, the searches per Topic (topics), how many searches have no Explore Topic (ungroupedCount; name a Topic for them with topicName), searches already tracked on another cadence (cadenceChanges) and whether confirmation is required.

body.description: Optional complete canonical activationPreview body; explicit fields override it.

cadence.description: Refresh cadence; defaults to weekly. Each refresh is charged when it collects.

sourcePlatforms.description: Platforms to track the selected searches on, for example ["tiktok"].

topicName.description: Topic for selected searches Explore left ungrouped; every other search is tracked under its Explore Topic. An existing Topic with the same name is reused. Needed only when the preview reports ungroupedCount > 0.

name: socialseal_explore_preview_activation
title: Preview Explore activation
